descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在布宜诺斯艾利斯吃烤馅饼后画的菜单，记号指着自己这份肉馅。
descriptions.en: A Buenos Aires empanada menu marking the messenger’s meat filling.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在布宜诺斯艾利斯吃过吉拿棒后画的干净菜单。
descriptions.en: A clean menu drawing after churros in Buenos Aires.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 金属花前的原创草稿，信使把花瓣画得有点像勺子。
descriptions.en: An original Floralis Genérica draft with a rather spoon-like petal.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使回想布宜诺斯艾利斯吉拿棒时画的点点便纸。
descriptions.en: A dotted paper made while recalling Buenos Aires churros.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自画的布宜诺斯艾利斯植物园轮廓纸，没有夹带植物。
descriptions.en: A homemade botanical-garden outline from Buenos Aires, carrying only drawings.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 沿金属花轮廓重画后折成的原创纸卡，中间留白。
descriptions.en: An original folded card with a redrawn Floralis Genérica outline and an open middle.
